signature_matches.name: extract resource via kernel32 functions
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: extract resource via kernel32 functions
    namespace: executable/resource
    authors:
      - william.ballenthin@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: thread
    examples:
      - BF88E1BD4A3BDE10B419A622278F1FF7:0x401000
      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 01-04.exe_:0x4011FC
      # ntdll
      - 563653399B82CD443F120ECEFF836EA3678D4CF11D9B351BB737573C2D856299:0x140001ABA
  features:
    - or:
      - and:
        - or:
          - api: kernel32.LoadResource
          - api: kernel32.LockResource
          - api: LdrAccessResource
        - optional:
          - api: kernel32.GetModuleHandle
          # may occur in parent function, see 0664B09A86EC2DF7DFE01A93E184A1FA23DF66EA82CAB39000944E418EC1F7B2
          - or:
            - api: kernel32.FindResource
            - api: kernel32.FindResourceEx
            - api: LdrFindResource_U
            - api: LdrFindResourceEx_U
          - api: kernel32.SizeofResource
          - api: kernel32.FreeResource

signature_matches.name: get OS version
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: get OS version
    authors:
      - "@mr-tz"
    lib: true
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: call
    examples:
      - 493167E85E45363D09495D0841C30648:0x401000
      - 5f66b82558ca92e54e77f216ef4c066c:0x44580A
  features:
    - or:
      - api: RtlGetVersion
      - api: ntoskrnl.PsGetVersion
      - api: GetVersion
      - api: GetVersionEx
      - api: VerifyVersionInfo
      - api: VerSetConditionMask
      - api: RtlGetNtVersionNumbers
      - api: GetProductInfo
      - and:
        - match: PEB access
        - or:
          - and:
            - arch: i386
            - or:
              - offset: 0xA4 = PEB->OSMajorVersion
              - offset: 0xA8 = PEB->OSMinorVersion
              - offset: 0xAC = PEB->OSBuildNumber
          - and:
            - arch: amd64
            - or:
              - offset: 0x118 = PEB->OSMajorVersion
              - offset: 0x11C = PEB->OSMinorVersion
              - offset: 0x120 = PEB->OSBuildNumber

signature_matches.name: link many functions at runtime
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: link many functions at runtime
    namespace: linking/runtime-linking
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
      - joakim@intezer.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: thread
    att&ck:
      - Execution::Shared Modules [T1129]
    examples:
      - b7b5e1253710d8927cbe07d52d2d2e10:0x401000
  features:
    - or:
      - and:
        - os: windows
        - match: link function at runtime on Windows
        - or:
          - count(api(kernel32.GetProcAddress)): 5 or more
          - count(api(ntdll.LdrGetProcedureAddress)): 5 or more
      - and:
        - or:
          - os: linux
          - os: android
        - match: link function at runtime on Linux
        - or:
          - count(api(dlsym)): 5 or more
          - count(api(dlvsym)): 5 or more

signature_matches.name: stealth_network
signature_matches.description: Network activity detected but not expressed in monitor API logs
PE / OLE file has an invalid certificate
PE file has an executable .text section and no other executable section
Sample tries to load a library which is not present or installed on the analysis machine, adding the library might reveal more behavior
PE file has a high image base, often used for DLLs
Contains modern PE file flags such as dynamic base (ASLR) or NX
Program does not show much activity (idle)
PE file contains a mix of resources often seen in goodware
PE file contains sections with non-standard names
URLs found in memory or binary data
